title: 第157章 顿悟黄阶中品剑意四目 这是人第156章 论底蕴我这当师父的还不如徒弟
slug: 九叔饲养百倍返还僵尸成旱魃
content_zh:
随着他凝神观想，画中那股能镇压诸天邪秽的真武神意，却在眼前一点点放大，仿佛要从纸面上跃然而出。
苏辰的目光渐渐失去焦距，呼吸也随之放缓。
下一刻，他识海之中，那尊本就存在的真武大帝法相自行显现。
嗡——
眼前的观想图微微一颤。
一缕缕淡金色光芒从画中飘出，径直没入苏辰眉心。
识海之内。
原本还有几分虚幻的真武法相，像是得到了某种本源的补全。
玄袍上的神秘纹路逐渐清晰，手中的神剑也从模糊的轮廓，一点点凝成实质。
一缕剑意自剑锋上升起。
并且越来越多的真武剑意，围绕着法相缓缓流转。
摆在苏辰身侧的七星剑，忽然轻轻震动起来。
锵——
一声清越的剑鸣，突兀响起。
七枚黄铜星钉依次亮起刺目的光芒。
点点璀璨的星光从剑身上溢出，汇成一条纤细的光线，同样没入他的眉心。
随着星光融入，识海中那一缕缕真武剑意明显凝实了数分。
与此同时，真武大帝脚下的龟蛇虚影也在发生翻天覆地的变化。
一股与剑意截然不同的镇煞气息，宛如潮水般向四周扩散开来。
放在外面的玄纹龟甲随之亮起。

甲壳上的天然纹路一根接一根浮现，隐约勾勒出龟蛇盘踞之形。
镇煞印也轻轻一震，印钮上的玄龟灵蛇虚影直接脱离了法印，在苏辰头顶盘旋了一圈，仰首发出一道无声却震慑神魂的嘶吼。
蛇皮腰带，也被气息牵引，自行缠向他的腰腹之间。
三件宝物各自溢出一缕本源气息。
三股力量彼此交织勾连，先后没入苏辰眉心。
轰！
苏辰的识海骤然发出一声雷霆般的轰鸣。
真武大帝法相瞬间凝实了三分。
玄袍无风狂舞，脚下龟蛇盘伏低吼。
手中那柄神剑，缩小飞在空中，自动演练。
一式式剑招，在苏辰识海中接连不断地展开。
招式并不繁复，可每一剑落下，真武剑意却比之前越发强大。
苏辰眼前金光涌动。
那些剑招直接烙印进了他的神魂最深处。
他的右手忽然抬起，一把握住悬浮在身前的七星剑。
双眼依旧迷离，身体却已经自行站立起来。
一步踏出，来到院中。
唰！
七星剑横斩而出。
一缕淡金剑光贴着剑锋划过，在院中留下短促的破空声。

紧接着，苏辰脚步一转。
第二剑由下而上。
content_en:
As he concentrated on contemplation, the true martial spirit in the painting, which could suppress the evil in the world, was gradually enlarged in front of his eyes, as if it was about to jump out of the paper.
Su Chen's eyes gradually lost focus and his breathing slowed down.
The next moment, in his sea of ​​consciousness, the already existing Dharma of Emperor Zhenwu appeared on its own.
Buzz——
The visualization picture in front of me trembled slightly.
Wisps of pale golden light floated out from the painting and went straight into Su Chen's eyebrows.
Within the sea of ​​consciousness.
The original Zhenwu Dharma, which was still somewhat illusory, seems to have been supplemented by some kind of origin.
The mysterious lines on the mysterious robe gradually became clearer, and the divine sword in his hand also condensed from a vague outline into substance bit by bit.
A wisp of sword intent rose from the sword's edge.
And more and more Zhenwu Sword Intention slowly circulates around the Dharma.
The Seven-Star Sword placed beside Su Chen suddenly vibrated slightly.
Qiang——
A clear sword sound suddenly sounded.
The seven brass star nails lit up with dazzling light in turn.
Dots of bright starlight overflowed from the sword, converging into a slender line of light that also sank into his eyebrows.
As the starlight merged, the wisps of Zhenwu Sword Intention in the sea of ​​​​consciousness clearly solidified several points.
At the same time, the tortoise and snake phantom at the feet of Emperor Zhenwu was also undergoing earth-shaking changes.
An evil-suppressing aura that is completely different from the sword's intention spreads around like a tide.
The mysterious tortoise shell placed outside lit up.
The natural lines on the carapace emerge one after another, vaguely outlining the shape of a turtle and snake entwining.
The evil-suppressing seal also shook slightly, and the phantom of the black turtle and spirit snake on the seal broke away from the seal, circled around Su Chen's head, raised his head and let out a silent but soul-shaking roar.
The snakeskin belt was also pulled by the breath and wrapped around his waist.
Each of the three treasures exuded a ray of original aura.
The three forces were intertwined and connected with each other, and they entered Su Chen's eyebrows one after another.
boom!
Su Chen's sea of ​​consciousness suddenly let out a thunderous roar.
Emperor Zhenwu's Dharma image instantly solidified by three points.
The mysterious robe danced wildly in the wind, while turtles and snakes coiled under their feet and roared.
The divine sword in his hand shrank and flew in the air, practicing automatically.
A series of sword moves unfolded one after another in Su Chen's sea of ​​consciousness.
The moves are not complicated, but every time the sword falls, the Zhenwu Sword Intent becomes more powerful than before.
Su Chen's eyes flashed with golden light.
Those sword moves were directly imprinted into the deepest part of his soul.
His right hand suddenly raised and grasped the Seven Star Sword suspended in front of him.
His eyes were still blurred, but his body had stood up on its own.
Take one step forward and arrive at the courtyard.
Uh-huh!
The seven-star sword slashed out.
A ray of light golden sword light passed across the sword's edge, leaving a short sound of breaking through the air in the courtyard.
Immediately afterwards, Su Chen turned around.
The second sword is from bottom to top.
